Doresain has no limbs because iirc, it was devoured by him and other ghouls prior to/during his ascension as the king of Necrovia, and it still haunts him to this day because he still wishes to devour his body once more...

Base Murphy is a very sad and disturbing character, but I won't comment further because it will spoil her entire chapter. However, if you do look at her battle sprite, the tentacle dress is shaped in a way that is reminiscent of a pregnant woman's belly...

text: 6:05 yes and no. The characters in the game which we call Awakeners basically underwent a form of second birth impacted by the main eldrich calamity in the game called dissolution (a phenomena that dissolves things and people and also the memories of them an any trace they left in reality) and during that rebirth most (but not all) of them basically had to rebuild themselves from scratch around their silver core which contains their soul mind and memory, so both that and their environment will influences what they'll look like. Furthermore awakeners can rebuild themselves from nothing as long as they core is intact which means they can change over time (which you mostly see in their individual quests). However a few of them absolutely did fuse with eldrich entities or just straight out are eldrich entities in the first place.
